The '''Seventeenth Assembly of Tamil Nadu''' succeeded the [[16th Tamil Nadu Assembly|Sixteenth Assembly of Tamil Nadu]] and was constituted after the [[2026 Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly election|April 2026 State Assembly elections]], which resulted in a [[Hung Parliament|Hung Assembly]] for the second time in the state's history, with no party or alliance reaching the majority mark, since [[1952 Madras State Legislative Assembly election|1952 election]] when [[Indian National Congress|INC]] was the largest party with no majority in the [[1st Madras Assembly]].
